title: Audiences
subtitle: Turn real buyers into TikTok audiences.
explain: WOB uploads the WhatsApp numbers of your real buyers (hashed, never readable) to TikTok, so ads can find more people like them. Audiences refresh every week.
createHint: Leads in this group right now: {{n}}.
name: Audience name
lookalikeHint: TikTok builds lookalikes only from audiences with at least {{min}} matched people.
lookalikeLater: Audience created. It's too small for a lookalike yet; make one from the list once it reaches the minimum.
noBuyers: Not enough buyers yet. Once the AI marks chats as buyers, you can build an audience from them.
tooSmall: Too small to use yet (TikTok needs {{min}}). It keeps growing every week.
notConnected: Connect a TikTok ad account to build audiences.
reconnect: TikTok needs you to reconnect so WOB can manage audiences.
